imgApi.title: Image API
imgApi.intro: Add a tile string to the URL path to get an SVG image you can embed directly. The tile path is required. Theme and color fall back to their defaults when omitted.
imgApi.encodingIntro: When building a URL in code, encode the tile string with `encodeURIComponent(tile)` so spaces and special characters are safe in the path.
imgApi.convertIntro: Swap the <from>?tile=</from> in a home-page share URL for the <to>/img/</to> path to get the matching SVG image. The other parameters stay the same.
imgApi.paramTileDesc: The tile string, placed in the path after `/img/`, for example `/img/7m7m7m2p3p4p`. Each tile is a number followed by a suit letter: `m` for characters, `p` for circles, `s` for bamboo, `z` for honors (East/South/West/North/White/Green/Red are `1z` to `7z`). Use `_` for a gap between tile groups, for example `123m456p_5z`. This path is required. If no tiles can be rendered, the endpoint returns HTTP 400 (`No tiles to render`).
imgApi.paramThemeDesc: Tile color theme. `color` for colorful tiles, `mono` for monochrome (black and white). Any other value defaults to `color`.
imgApi.paramColorDesc: Main tile color, a six-digit hex code **without** the `#`, for example `2D7D46`. Only applies when `theme=color`; ignored when `theme=mono`.
imgApi.inputRules: Tile notation is limited to 512 characters; invalid color codes use the default color.
